summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of Nocturnum LARP landing page. All major features working correctly including navigation, language toggle, gallery lightbox, FAQ accordion, and mobile responsiveness.
passed_tests: Hero section displays with background image and CTA button
Navigation bar shows all 5 sections with smooth scrolling
Language toggle IT/EN switches text content correctly
Story section displays 3 info cards (location, date, players)
Rules section shows 3 Nordic LARP rule cards with icons
Gallery displays 4 images with working lightbox functionality
Register CTA button links to Google Forms correctly
Footer displays 5 social links and contact email
Mobile responsive design with working mobile menu
Mobile navigation toggle opens/closes menu correctly
Language toggle works on mobile viewport
